{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A resolution to renew Trade Promotion Authority was made in 2000 so the President could more easily negotiate trade agreements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and Republicans in Congress renewed Trade Promotion Authority in 2002 after it had lapsed for eight years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The renewed Trade Promotion Authority allows President Bush to work with other countries to reduce barriers to U.S. products and services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Bush Administration has negotiated trade agreements with 12 countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Progress has been made on agreements with another 10 countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 12 countries with which trade agreements have been negotiated, and the 10 countries with which progress has been made on agreements, represent $2.5 trillion in purchasing power, equivalent to America's third-largest export market.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The agreements include high levels of protection and strong enforcement measures for intellectual property.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has made significant progress in negotiating multi-lateral trade agreements, having revived World Trade Organization (WTO) negotiations for the final phase of the Doha round last month.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"The revival of WTO negotiations opens the door to lower tariffs on consumer and industrial goods.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The revival of WTO negotiations opens the door to reductions in tariffs and trade-distorting export subsidies on agricultural products.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The revival of WTO negotiations opens the door to market access and lower regulatory barriers for services.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
